This supplement **is** the notebooks in this folder. It does not re-run
simulations. Paths and outputs live under **`clean/`**
(`data_root()` → `clean/data/…`). Shared engine: **FLBacktest**.

Knit from `clean/` with `Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R` (see
[`../README.md`](../README.md) and [`README.md`](README.md)).

# Funder draft vs peer-review manuscript

| Deliverable | Closed-loop treatment | Where |
|-------------|----------------------|--------|
| Funder / contract | Perfect-information `hcrICES` on true OM SSB (**bh3**) | `02.2`, `tex/report.tex` |
| Peer-review draft | SAM management procedure (survey OEM → SAM → forecast → HCR), all four case studies; perfect information reported as the no-assessment-error bound | `02.4.1` fit, `02.4.2` loop (`--only sam`), `scripts/manuscript_sam.R`, `tex/manuscript.tex` |
| Peer-review robustness | SAM MP over 100 survey realisations (CV 0.3), `scn0`–`scn2` | `02.4.3` (`--only sam_mc`) |
| Optional bound | Short-cut OEM (`eqSimErr` on SSB) | `02.3` (`--only shortcut`) |

Open-loop ICES \(F_{\mathrm{tar}}\) and OM \(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\) are no-feedback
benchmarks in both. Multi-SRR tables for revision:
[`04.1_multiSRR_review.Rmd`](04.1_multiSRR_review.Rmd)
(`BM_CLOSED_SRR=all` on `02.2` for full Advice-rule coverage).

# Notebooks

## Operating model and gate

### [`01.0_condition_om.Rmd`](01.0_condition_om.Rmd)

Load and clean WGCSE stocks; fit six SRR scenarios (`bh1`–`bh3`, `rk1`–`rk3`)
plus diagnostic `scn0`–`scn2`; attach SAG benchmarks; seed
`data/reference/` from the parent tree if missing (`ensure_seed_inputs()`).

Writes `data/om/oms.RData`, `eqls.RData`, `sag.RData`, `recDevs.RData`.

### [`01.1_lterm_eq.Rmd`](01.1_lterm_eq.Rmd)

**Required** before open-/closed-loop. 50-year deterministic `fwd` at FLBRP
\(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\) vs `refpts` (`ltermEq` / `ltermPass`, `biology = "brp"`).
Stops if any stock fails. `require_om_gate()` in later notebooks reads
`data/results/01.1_lterm_eq.RData`.

### [`01.2_dynamics.Rmd`](01.2_dynamics.Rmd)

Dynamics diagnostics (SPR0, process error, realised status, compact
`fwd` vs FLBRP). Writes `data/results/01.2_dynamics.RData` and
`data/interim/01.2_dynamics/`.

## Backtest

### [`02.1_openLoop.Rmd`](02.1_openLoop.Rmd)

Constant-\(F\) projections: published ICES \(F_{\mathrm{tar}}\) and each
scenario's OM \(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\) (six SRRs). No biomass feedback.

Writes `data/results/02.1_openLoop.RData`.

### [`02.2_closedLoop.Rmd`](02.2_closedLoop.Rmd)

Closed-loop `hcrICES` from 2015: perfect information (true OM SSB), residual
replay, zero implementation error, \(\pm20\%\) TAC clause above
\(B_{\mathrm{trigger}}\). Default OM branch **bh3**; set `BM_CLOSED_SRR=all`
for six SRRs.

Writes `data/results/02.2_closedLoop.RData`.

### [`02.3_closedLoop_shortcut.Rmd`](02.3_closedLoop_shortcut.Rmd)

Optional. Same HCR with `eqSimErr` observation error on SSB.
`Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R --only shortcut`.

### [`02.4.1_sam.Rmd`](02.4.1_sam.Rmd)

Optional for the funder knit. SAM OEM survey and one SAM fit per stock,
compared with the OM; stops if a fit fails or is off scale. Check before the
closed loop. Stocks: SAM assessments in `stocks.csv` plus Irish Sea cod
(`sam_extra` in `R/sam_oem.R`; its ICES assessment is not SAM).
Catch-at-age placeholders (\(\le 10^{-3}\), e.g. Celtic Sea cod ages 1–2
before 2004) are passed to SAM as missing; ages with no catch at all keep
them. Writes `data/results/02.4.1_sam.RData`.
`Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R --only sam_fit`.

### [`02.4.2_closedLoop_sam.Rmd`](02.4.2_closedLoop_sam.Rmd)

**Closed-loop arm of the peer-review manuscript.** `hcrICES` with the
`02.4.1` OEM, refitting SAM each advice year. `BM_SAM_STAGE`: `loop`
(default, **bh3**) or `srr` (six SRRs). Writes
`data/results/02.4.2_closedLoop_sam.RData`.
`Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R --only sam_loop`.

### [`02.4.3_closedLoop_sam_mc.Rmd`](02.4.3_closedLoop_sam_mc.Rmd)

SAM closed loop repeated over survey realisations: 100 iterations, survey
CV 0.3, OM SRRs `scn0`–`scn2` (overrides `BM_SAM_MC_NITS`, `BM_SAM_MC_CV`,
`BM_SAM_MC_CORES`). Each (SRR, stock, iteration) is a single-iteration run
on a PSOCK cluster, cached under `data/interim/02.4.3_closedLoop_sam_mc/`
so a re-knit resumes. Writes `data/results/02.4.3_closedLoop_sam_mc.RData`.
`Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R --only sam_mc`.

### [`02.5_rebuild.Rmd`](02.5_rebuild.Rmd)

20-year Future from Historical and Advice-rule terminal states (mean
recruitment; **bh3**). Writes `data/results/02.5_rebuild.RData`.

## Digests and figures

### [`03.0_digest.Rmd`](03.0_digest.Rmd)

All-stock terminal summary table. Writes `data/results/03.0_digest.RData`.

### [`04.0_paper_figures.Rmd`](04.0_paper_figures.Rmd)

Loads saved results; short digest and `FLCore::plot` checks. Published
facets are scripts (below), not this notebook.

### [`04.1_multiSRR_review.Rmd`](04.1_multiSRR_review.Rmd)

Peer-review only: stock × SRR summary from open loop (six SRRs) and whatever
closed-loop SRRs are present. Does not edit `tex/report.tex`.

# Figure scripts

Run from `clean/` (also invoked by the pipeline `paper` step):

| Script | Output under `clean/tex/figs/` |
|--------|--------------------------------|
| [`../scripts/advice_catch_casestudy.R`](../scripts/advice_catch_casestudy.R) | `advice_catch_casestudy.pdf` (+ `.png`) — ASD advice vs SAG catch |
| [`../scripts/main_traj_facet.R`](../scripts/main_traj_facet.R) | `traj_facet.pdf` (+ `.png`) — Historical vs perfect-information Advice rule (funder); with `BM_TRAJ_MP=sam`, `traj_facet_sam.pdf` — Advice rule = SAM MP (manuscript Figure 3) |
| [`../scripts/manuscript_sam.R`](../scripts/manuscript_sam.R) | `data/results/04.2_manuscript_sam.RData` — manuscript tables (SAM MP, perfect-information bound, 20-year rebuild); run before `BM_TRAJ_MP=sam` |

Needs `data/om/sag.RData` (and network for ASD) for the advice–catch figure.

# Knit order

```
01.0_condition_om.Rmd
        ├── 01.1_lterm_eq.Rmd          (required gate)
        └── 01.2_dynamics.Rmd          (required diagnostics)
02.1_openLoop.Rmd
02.2_closedLoop.Rmd                    (funder closed loop; bh3)
        └── 02.5_rebuild.Rmd
03.0_digest.Rmd
04.0_paper_figures.Rmd
        + advice_catch_casestudy.R
        + main_traj_facet.R
04.1_multiSRR_review.Rmd               (peer-review; optional)

Optional: 02.3_closedLoop_shortcut.Rmd

Manuscript (SAM MP):
02.4.1_sam.Rmd                         (check fits first)
        └── 02.4.2_closedLoop_sam.Rmd
                └── scripts/manuscript_sam.R
                        └── BM_TRAJ_MP=sam scripts/main_traj_facet.R
02.4.3_closedLoop_sam_mc.Rmd           (observation-error iterations)
```

`01.1` is a hard stop for `02.1` / `02.2` via `require_om_gate()`.
Knit `00_supplement.Rmd` anytime; it is an index.

# Not in this tree

Parent screening-of-six, `01.cod_*`, `06.1_TwoStocks`, `06.2_generic`,
`06.0_report.Rmd` (replaced by `04.0` + figure scripts), and the parent
`R/plot_theme.R` kitchen-sink. LaTeX: `clean/tex/report.tex` (funder),
`clean/tex/manuscript.tex` (peer-review assembly).
